Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Hefferline was at the University of Southern California based on a search-result snippet and equated “USC” with Southern California, then proceeded to fetch that city (Los Angeles) without verifying the affiliation. In reality, Ralph Hefferline was a psychology professor at Columbia University in New York City. The error was relying on an unverified snippet and misinterpreting “USC,” leading to the wrong city.
